title: DSPlacer: DSP Placement for FPGA-based CNN Accelerator
problem: FPGA-based CNN accelerator placement suffers from timing closure challenges; DSP placement directly impacts clock frequency and throughput but lacks automated optimization.
motivation: CNN acceleration on FPGAs requires extracting performance from limited DSP resources through optimal placement to achieve timing closure at higher frequencies.
method: DSPlacer optimizes datapath DSP placement iteratively using graph convolutional network-based identification, DSP graph construction, min-cost-flow assignment, and integer linear programming (ILP) for cascade constraint legalization.
key_novelty: First comprehensive framework combining GCN-based DSP identification, min-cost-flow assignment, and ILP-based cascade legalization for CNN accelerator timing optimization.
contributions: Min-cost-flow based DSP assignment to compact layout
32% WNS improvement vs Vivado 2020.2, 65% vs AMF-Placer 2.0

metrics.other: 32% WNS improvement vs Vivado, 65% vs AMF-Placer

primary_theme: automated DSP placement for FPGA CNN accelerators
